current_candidate.summary: Spaces v20 fixes the mobile scene selector so all five map options are reachable by finger. The strip now has real horizontal pan behavior, explicit pointer-drag fallback scrolling, click suppression after a drag, and automatic centering of the selected scene.

open_feedback: Verify on phone: drag the scene selector horizontally with a finger and reach maps 4 and 5.
